newsitem.title: GERMANY: Three Turks die in blaze in western Germany.
newsitem.headline: Three Turks die in blaze in western Germany.

text.p: Three members of a Turkish family died after fire broke out in their apartment in the west German town of Krefeld overnight and investigators believe the blaze may have been started deliberately, police said on Monday.
A police spokesman said prosecutors and murder squad detectives had begun investigations but there was no evidence to suggest a racially motivated attack.

One of the victims, a 41-year-old woman, was fatally injured after jumping from the third-floor flat in a high-rise block in the town centre. A 16-year-old girl died in hospital from her injuries and a 17-year-old youth was found dead in the building.
Two female members of the family, aged 19 and 16, also jumped out of the flat and were taken to hospital with serious injuries, police said.
